jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

jobs.occupation: ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d) (ERP-Berater/in - ERP-Consultant)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our Digital Transformation team, Airbus is looking for a

ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d)

The Mission & Scope

Airbus Aerostructures is pioneering its digital transformation, and we are seeking a proactive SAP Technical Expert with a strong leadership mindset. You will bridge architectural vision and hands-on execution, ensuring seamless business continuity across our legacy systems while steering operational readiness for our S/4HANA Cloud transition.

Scope: Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technical Solutions, S/4HANA Cloud, and SAP BTP.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Operations (On-Premise & Cloud): Act as the primary technical SME and lead deep-level administration, HANA DB optimization, trace analysis, and central infrastructure orchestration (Cloud Connectors, Web Dispatchers, STMS/ChaRM, SSO) across hybrid environments.
- Advanced S/4HANA Operations & Migrations: Lead S/4HANA conversion activities—including advanced SUM/DMO transitions—and manage S/4HANA Cloud testing landscapes, system refreshes, and target provisioning.
- Lifecycle Management, Monitoring & Automation: Drive system enhancements and release cycles, manage high-availability/disaster recovery setups, implement observability frameworks (SAP Cloud ALM / BTP), and design Infrastructure-as-Code workflows to automate standard BASIS routines.
- Security, Compliance & Audit Readiness: Enforce system hardening, patch orchestration, and SSL/TLS certificate management. Monitor security/gateway logs, remediate vulnerabilities, and lead technical preparations for internal and external SAP audits in alignment with cybersecurity standards.
- Project Management & Service Leadership: Ideate, steer, and deliver complex technical projects to optimize ERP performance and transformations. Drive continuous improvement in partner service delivery and manage connectivity pipelines (REST/SOAP/RFC APIs, SAP Event Mesh) across cross-functional teams.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Degree in Computer Science / Business Informatics OR a vocational degree as an IT Specialist with proven advanced training.
- Experience & Mindset: Multi-year track record in SAP BASIS and platform infrastructure administration for complex hybrid landscapes, paired with a project-leading mindset.
- Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP HANA DB (Linux/Windows), SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, and SAP Cloud ALM.
- Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills in complex, matrixed organizations.
- Languages: Proficient in English; German language skills are a strong advantage

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.

Your role:

As Senior Controller FP&A, you will act as a trusted business partner to the Electronics Leadership Team and serve as the functional CFO for SG&A. You will provide fact-based financial analysis that enables timely, well-informed decisions across SG&A and selected strategic initiatives. You will lead the end-to-end SG&A planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycle, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with corporate guidelines. You will develop financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses to support strategic planning and effective resource allocation. You will also contribute to long-range financial planning across the Electronics business. A key part of your role will be accelerating the use of AI and advanced analytics across FP&A, from data preparation and variance analysis to reporting automation, narrative generation, and self-service insights. Working closely with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, you will identify, evaluate, and implement scalable AI-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort and improve decision support. You will help strengthen finance processes, reporting capabilities, and data quality so that AI-driven outputs are reliable and actionable. As a credible advocate for innovation, you will encourage the adoption of AI tools and digital ways of working across the Finance community. Throughout, you will communicate financial performance and strategic priorities clearly and transparently to stakeholders at all levels.

Who you are:

- 
You have 5 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, FP&A, accounting, or corporate finance, ideally within a large, international organization.

- 
You bring a solid understanding of financial planning, management reporting, and performance management processes, combined with strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities.

- 
You have contributed to or led finance digitalization, automation, or AI initiatives in a professional environment and are genuinely motivated to translate emerging technologies into practical Finance applications.

- 
You are proficient in finance planning and reporting systems such as TM1, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, or Analysis for Office.

- 
You have working knowledge of AI and analytics tools used in Finance, such as Microsoft Copilot, Python for data analysis, or equivalent platforms.

- 
You have advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with automation or AI-assisted workflows in these tools is an advantage.

- 
You communicate complex financial information clearly and concisely, engage and influence senior stakeholders effectively, and work confidently in a dynamic, matrixed environment.

- 
You are solution-oriented, self-driven, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with strong interpersonal skills, a professional communication style, and fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are an asset.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our flight controls engineering department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Systems Engineer for Flight Controls (High Lift Systems) (d/f/m).

Are you looking for a career opportunity in an international, high-tech environment? Regardless of your experience level, you might want to join our highly motivated team! We are developing, designing, and supporting leading-edge technology, complex, and safety-critical architectures for the High Lift System of flight controls across the Airbus product line using modern development methods and tools.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country's greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It's also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour's drive from the North Sea coast.

Our Benefits for You

Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.

Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Design, development, and integration of the High Lift System and its sub-system control architecture.
- Application of automated controls technology in flight control systems, including assessment of filtering, estimation, and stability needs.
- Definition and identification of checks and balances along the development cycle to ensure product maturity across milestone gates.
- Identification of lifecycle activities to develop, maintain, and support the design/product.
- Definition of work package contents and activities.

Desired skills and qualifications

- University degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in electrical engineering, information technology, systems engineering, or a related field.
- Broad knowledge in at least two relevant disciplines (e.g., communication/controls technology, sensing and data generation, software development, or systems engineering).
- Good understanding of tool applications in Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and/or software development. Knowledge of data analytics would be a plus.
- Strong team player with good communication skills, personal engagement, and adaptability to work in an international environment.
- Willingness to travel for business up to once a month worldwide.
- Advanced language skills in English and German; French skills are an asset.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
